descriptions.w3d_d31e_transform_children_801ad168: Runs a transform pass over the child list at +44 of a tree: for each child calls the handler selected by the child's kind at +6. On failure returns the error. A replacement in the result reference at +96 is either appended to the task (flag set) or stored into a child slot of the tree, copying the tree first through 0x801ad108 unless already copied or preserved. Children marked changed at +88 are appended, or their indices pushed on a real STLport vector and erased after the loop. Leaves the copy in the result and the flag in +88. Names are inferred.
